name: scwbs
description: CLI for SC-WBS Development with WBS-JSON integration.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:coverage:all: vitest run tests/unit tests/integration --coverage --coverage.reporter=text --coverage.reporter=json-summary --pool=forks --maxWorkers=4 --no-file-parallelism --testTimeout=60000 --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile.json=coverage/test-results.json -t='^(?!.*bounds events per Task and receipts per repository)(?!.*health receipts retain at most 50 events for at most 100 Tasks)'
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:integration && npm run test:wjs
